title: Patch: fused Spells, Combo-Index grades and KY's Constant off the field
notes: Issue #3800: engine and card fixes for the daily fuzz. A fused Spell is flagged for the end-of-turn return only for a Spell ingredient's end-of-turn text, and from its graveyard runs no Unit's, Field Spell's or Trap's end-of-turn text (R3800000; Duos seed 1628). A Combo-Index text run after its card left the field writes no grade (R3800001; seed 6091). A cost set on a card in a graveyard or an exile pile changes nothing (R3800002; seed 6140). C+ #37 Wardrum's end of turn casts from the non-Units played before the turn's end began, not another Wardrum's copies (R3800003; seed 5763). S+ #104 Tireless Cultivation's Radiant face gives its Temporary 2 only to a card that reaches the hand, not one a full hand burned (seed 8687). Flak v3, v4 and v5 keep their `damage` script through v0.5.8b, so a past version from v0.5.8b no longer panics (R767000; seed 5172). No catalog change: the plays are the families `classify` finds playing differently in its forced and unforced games.

player.title: Fused cards behave off the field
fixes: A fused Spell no longer returns to your hand, or gains keywords in your graveyard, because of a Unit's, Field Spell's or Trap's end-of-turn text fused into it.
A Combo-Index card that left the field mid-effect no longer keeps a grade.
Setting the cost of a card that was just discarded or exiled no longer changes its price.
Several Radiant Wardrums no longer recast each other's copies at the end of your turn: each casts the Spells, Field Spells and Traps you played before the turn ended.
A Radiant Tireless Cultivation burned by a full hand no longer keeps its Temporary in your graveyard.
